findings.title: exact resume、terminal replay 与并发 generation safety 尚未实现
findings.problem: resumeRun 在发现 result.json 时直接抛出 EXACT_RESUME_NOT_PENDING，admitActionResult 对 terminal Run 也只会落入 RUN_NOT_PENDING/RUN_TERMINAL；接口没有 persisted terminal/equivalent/conflicting replay outcome，也没有保存并比较 canonical logical descriptor digest。prepareNewExecution 的 pending 检查与 allocator/create 之间亦没有同一原子边界，两个并发 caller 可同时越过检查。
findings.contractRef: design.md Decision 3；specs/flowkit-lean-run-and-action-package Requirement: new preparation 与 exact Run resume 必须是不同入口；Requirement: terminal replay 必须 exact 且幂等
findings.invariant: target-pinned retry 必须在 exact persisted Run 上幂等恢复；同一 legal boundary 的并发 new preparation 至多发布一个 pending Run，不能因 timeout、late completion 或 race 推进 generation。
findings.requiredOutcome: 实现 persisted pending/terminal exact-resume result union、canonical logical descriptor binding、equivalent/conflicting replay，以及覆盖 pending check 与 allocator/create 的 Core 原子唯一性；补齐 timeout、late completion、concurrent caller 和 wrong Run/descriptor tests。
acceptance: exact retry 指向 terminal Run 时返回 persisted terminal 或 equivalent replay outcome，不调用 Policy/allocator
不同 logical descriptor、Role、Action、Run identity 的 replay deterministic fail closed
并发 next/review preparation 在同一 boundary 至多产生一个 pending Run，其余返回同一 persisted identity或 deterministic conflict
focused tests 覆盖 preparation timeout、late terminal、equivalent/conflicting replay、wrong Run id 与 generation safety

findings.title: post-action record 没有与 terminal result 建立可恢复的 exact binding
findings.problem: verification-selection record 在 completeRun 之前写入，但 terminal ActionResult 没有该 record 的 ResultRef/identity；record-present pending replay 只校验当前 canonical Markdown 的 hash，未校验 package、semantic fingerprint 与 logical descriptor。validatePublishedVerificationSelection 对所有调用都读取 mutable canonical verification.md，无法支持 historical terminal point-in-time replay。另有一个 validateVerificationSelectionRecord closed validator，其 schema 与实际 publication 多出的 producingSemanticInputFingerprint、selection、verificationMarkdownLogicalRef 字段不一致且未被 Reader 使用。
findings.contractRef: design.md Decisions 3 and 8；specs/flowkit-formal-fact-reader-and-persistence Requirement: post-action record 必须独立持久化；specs/flowkit-change-verification-selection Requirement: Core 必须发布 immutable verification-selection record
findings.invariant: commit marker 必须在 terminal CAS 前完整存在，并由 terminal result exact-bind；pending recovery 可检查 current Markdown，historical terminal replay只能校验 persisted result 与 immutable per-Run authority，不能读取未来 mutable bytes。
findings.requiredOutcome: 统一实际 record type与唯一 closed validator，在 terminal preflight/CAS 中 Core 派生并 exact-bind per-Run record identity及 logical descriptor；按 absent/Markdown-only/record+pending/terminal-present 四态实现恢复，historical terminal 路径不得读取 current Markdown。
acceptance: 实际 publication bytes 可被唯一 production closed validator完整验证，unknown/extra/malformed字段 fail closed
completed Apply/revise-apply result exact-bind producing Run 的 immutable record，缺失/mismatch 阻止 terminal CAS
record-present pending equivalent replay只执行 terminal CAS，conflicting replay fail closed
old terminal exact replay不读取未来 verification.md，且四态 crash/recovery tests 完整

findings.title: production actualChangeSet 错把 entry 当 canonical base
findings.problem: publishV5ApplyVerificationSelection 调用 derivePostActionChangeObservation(entry, entry, postAction, declaration)，所以 actualChangeSet 实际是 entry→post，而不是 canonical base→post。仓库虽有 deriveActualChangeSetFromCanonicalBase primitive，production call path没有使用它。
findings.contractRef: design.md Decision 6；tasks.md 4.2；specs/flowkit-change-verification-selection Requirement: Core 必须从 actualChangeSet 选择 verification scope
findings.invariant: actualChangeSet 必须描述 canonical base→post-action 的最终 candidate，并保留 Apply entry 时已经存在、Action 内未变化的 candidate bytes；observedActionMutations 才是 entry→post。
findings.requiredOutcome: 在 production admission 中从 persisted canonical base 重建真实 base state并派生 base→post actualChangeSet，同时独立保持 entry→post observedActionMutations；用 entry 已有 dirty candidate 的 service/integration test证明。
acceptance: production record包含 entry前已存在但Action内未变化的base差异
observedActionMutations仅包含entry后变化，并继续拒绝 declaration外路径
create/modify/delete、untracked、rename-like、line ending与reserved Core path测试通过production call path

findings.title: Formal Reader 未实现 current-lineage 与 pending publication 语义
findings.problem: readActiveChangeVerificationStatus 仅按最大 runId选择最近 completed apply/revise-apply；它不按 Policy/Review producer lineage判断 current producer，也不识别 pending Apply/revise-apply 已发布 Markdown/record 的 in-flight 状态。若后续 pending revision覆盖 canonical Markdown，它会拿旧 completed record对照新 bytes并产生历史 conflict。record读取也只是 loose object + 两字段比较。
findings.contractRef: design.md Decision 8 steps 1-5；tasks.md 5.6/5.8；specs/flowkit-formal-fact-reader-and-persistence Reader current-lineage scenarios
findings.invariant: Reader 只验证唯一 current applicable completed producer；pending publication使 projection unavailable/in-flight，不能升级为 authority或让旧 terminal对照future bytes。
findings.requiredOutcome: 按现有 review/revision lineage选择唯一 current producer，加入 pending publication in-flight投影，使用统一closed validator完整绑定 producer/result/record/current Markdown，并增加 Apply→review changes-requested→revise-apply old/new lineage tests。
acceptance: 初次Apply、被changes-requested的Apply、完成revise-apply三种lineage均选择正确唯一producer
pending Markdown-only或record publication均使Verification unavailable/in-flight，不比较previous terminal record与新bytes
current producer/record/result/Markdown任一缺失、歧义或mismatch fail closed
合法successor publication不产生historical FactConflict

findings.title: verification module authority、not-applicable 与 deterministic record contract 未闭合
findings.problem: module-map validator只检查module id排序、非空字段、unknown dependency、跨module ownership overlap和cycle；它接受module内部重复/乱序selectors、dependsOn/scopes/capabilities以及任意unknown scope/capability。VerificationModule/record没有noApplicable predicate/proof、module-map logical ref或capability relation outcome。renderer固定写入status not-run，current record又exact-bind该Markdown，因此正常v5 Apply无法形成passed Verification而不破坏binding。
findings.contractRef: design.md Decisions 7-8；tasks.md 5.1/5.4/5.5/5.7；specs/flowkit-change-verification-selection deterministic selection and explicit not-applicable requirements
findings.invariant: module/capability authority必须closed、唯一、稳定排序；not-applicable只能由closed predicate显式证明；record保存完整relation/proof authority并生成可进入正式Verification lifecycle的deterministic Markdown。
findings.requiredOutcome: 补全closed module/scope/capability/predicate schema与validator，保存module-map ref、relation outcome及可选not-applicable proof，定义并实现Verification status如何与immutable selection publication一致进入passed/failed/not-applicable lifecycle；补齐负向determinism tests。
acceptance: duplicate/overlap/unknown/cycle/nondeterministic module map全部fail closed
modules/capabilities/scopes stable sorted/deduped且record保存完整authority/ref/relation outcome
not-applicable只有closed predicate proof时可产生，missing mapping不得降级
v5 Apply后的canonical Verification可合法达到passed/failed/not-applicable而不破坏record binding

findings.title: OpenSpec projection 未跨完整 formal operation 共享，Windows cancellation 也只有无诊断 fallback
findings.problem: prepareNewExecution 先调用readSnapshot；Formal Reader在readOpenSpecArtifacts中自行new adapter/getChangeStatus，随后deriveSemanticInputs又创建另一OpenSpecOperationProjection，故同一preparation仍重复version/status process。Windows timeout分支只child.kill launcher后立即返回outcome-unknown，没有owned process-tree cancellation seam或launcher/descendant diagnostics。
findings.contractRef: design.md Decisions 4-5；tasks.md 3.1-3.6；specs/flowkit-openspec-1-7-thin-integration formal operation projection requirement；specs/flowkit-runtime-foundation Windows timeout requirements
findings.invariant: formal snapshot、contract refs、tasks、verification与prepared context必须共享一次operation projection；Windows无法证明process tree终止时必须保留可诊断的ownership/descendant信息并fail closed。
findings.requiredOutcome: 把一个OpenSpecOperationProjection贯穿每次完整formal read/preparation并用invocation-count/real CLI test证明；实现可注入的Windows owned process-tree cancellation seam，confirmed时返回timed-out-cancelled，无法确认时携带完整diagnostics返回outcome-unknown。
acceptance: 同一preparation中的snapshot/artifacts/tasks/verification/contract/action context共享一次version/status projection

fake与real CLI invocation-count tests覆盖完整operation而非单adapter方法
